title: On the Juche Philosophy
author: Kim Jong Il
desc: Fundamentos filosóficos del Juche como contribución al pensamiento marxista-leninista (Kim Jong Il, marzo 1982).
tesis: Fundamentación filosófica del Juche: Kim argumenta que el marxismo-leninismo es correcto pero incompleto — necesita una filosofía que ponga al ser humano (no la materia abstracta) en el centro. El Juche no niega el materialismo dialéctico sino que lo 'completa' con una antropología filosófica centrada en la creatividad, la conciencia y la independencia del ser humano.
ideas: El Juche acepta el materialismo dialéctico pero lo 'completa' con una filosofía centrada en el ser humano como sujeto creador.
La conciencia humana no es mero reflejo de la materia sino fuerza creadora que transforma la realidad.
La filosofía Juche se presenta como superación del determinismo mecánico del marxismo ortodoxo.
contexto: Publicado en 1985 por Ediciones en Lenguas Extranjeras de Pyongyang. Representa el intento de Kim Il Sung de fundamentar filosóficamente la idea Juche como sistema independiente del materialismo dialéctico soviético, en el contexto de la autonomía ideológica de Pyongyang respecto de Moscú y Pekín.

conexiones.razon: On the Juche Idea es la versión política; Philosophy es la versión filosófica del mismo proyecto.
Stalin sistematizó el diamat; Kim argumenta que necesita complementarse con una antropología filosófica.

quotes.text: The Juche philosophy is a new philosophy created by the great leader Comrade Kim Il Sung.

tl: Primera formulacion del Juche: independencia coreana

He explained the principles of the Juche idea at the Meeting of Leading Personnel of the Young Communist League and the Anti-Imperialist Youth League held at Kalun in June 1930 and put forward a Juche-oriented line for the Korean revolution.
Contra el adulamiento y el dogmatismo en la lucha antijaponesa

Those who were allegedly engaged in the communist movement formed their own party groups and called frequently at the Comintern to gain its recognition. And they endeavoured to imitate mechanically established theories and experience of others.
Independencia, creatividad y consciencia: los rasgos del hombre social
The Juche philosophy made it clear for the first time that independence, creativity and consciousness are the essential features of man, the social being.
Charla de abril de 1974: el hombre como amo del mundo

The Juche philosophy answered a new question–who is the master of the world and what is the motive force for its transformation. It elucidated a new idea of the world that nature and society are dominated and transformed by man.
Las masas como sujeto de la historia
The working masses are the subject of history and the motive force of social progress. History develops through the struggle of the masses to transform nature and society.
Economía nacional independiente frente al saqueo imperialista
It is vital to build an independent national economy particularly in those countries which were backward economically and technically because of imperialist domination and plunder in the past.
Autodefensa frente al imperialismo estadounidense
Imperialism is a constant cause of war, and the main force of aggression and war today is US imperialism.
Adulamiento al imperialismo estadounidense en el sur de Corea

What is most harmful and dangerous at present is flunkeyism towards US imperialism in particular. This servility, which is expressed in the fear and worship of the United States, is doing a great harm to the revolutionary struggle of the people.
Las tres revoluciones: ideológica, técnica y cultural
Holding high the banner of continuous revolution, our Party and people are carrying out to the letter the line of three revolutions–ideological, technological and cultural.
Tratado del 70 aniversario de Kim Il Sung
Our leader created the great Juche idea after acquiring a deep insight into the requirements of a new era when the oppressed and humiliated masses of the people became masters of their own destiny.
Contra la socialdemocracia moderna y la tercera vía

In this contemporary world there exist only two roads, socialism and capitalism. There cannot be anything like a "third road." The "third road," the road of social democracy, is the road to capitalism.
Mayo de 1990: defender el socialismo frente al desplome

Recently the imperialists are getting more and more frantic in their attempt to frustrate socialism. In step with their unprecedented intensification of anti-socialist machinations, various trends of thought, which distort and deny the ideal of socialism, are appearing.
Octubre de 1990: contra el evolucionismo en la lectura del Juche
Although man is a product of evolution, the essential attributes of man, a social being, are not products of evolution; they have been formed and developed socially and historically.
Filosofía política para guiar la revolución

We study philosophy essentially for the purpose of clarifying the principles and methodology by which to develop the society and shape the destiny of the masses. The development of society is guided by politics and it is none other than the Juche philosophy which clarifies the basic principles of politics.
Julio de 1996: el Juche como filosofía revolucionaria original

The Juche philosophy is an original philosophy which has been evolved and systematized with its own principles. The historic contribution made by the Juche philosophy to the development of philosophical thoughts lies not in its advancement of Marxist materialistic dialectics, but in its clarification of new philosophical principles centred on man.
